description: The chart illustrates the F1 Score (%) achieved by different model configurations across six datasets. The horizontal category axis is labeled "Dataset" and displays the categories in the following order: SMD, PSM, SWaT, SMAP, MSL, and WADI. The vertical value axis is labeled "F1 Score (%)" and uses a linear scale ranging from 60 to 100, with numeric tick labels spaced at intervals of 10. The chart features grouped vertical bars, where each dataset category contains a cluster of four adjacent bars representing different model configurations, as defined by a legend below the plot. These configurations are color-coded: light green for "MADLLM", purple for "MADLLM w/o feature embedding", blue for "MADLLM w/o prompt pool", and orange for "MADLLM w/o skip embedding". All bars feature a thin black outline. Across the chart, the tallest bar is the light green MADLLM configuration in the PSM dataset group, reaching an approximate value of 97%, while the shortest bar is the purple MADLLM w/o feature embedding configuration in the WADI dataset group, at approximately 62%. Within each dataset grouping, the light green MADLLM bar consistently displays the highest value. The dataset categories are not sorted in a strict alphabetical or numerical order, and no specific bars are visually emphasized beyond their standard color coding and outlines.
